children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may bounce further into the 4,930 ringgit-4,964 ringgit per metric ton, after breaking above a falling trendline.
The break suggests the completion of a wave C from 5,018 ringgit, which could be broken down into five smaller waves, a structure indicating the completion of the wave C as well.
The target zone of 4,930 ringgit to 4,964 ringgit will be confirmed when the market breaks 4,903 ringgit. A failure to overcome this barrier would suggest an invalid break above the trendline.
A break below 4,876 ringgit will not only trigger a drop to 4,820 ringgit-4,843 ringgit range, but also indicate a continuation of the downtrend.
On the daily chart, the consolidation from the August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit has taken the shape of either a flat pattern or a double-top.

Given that the uptrend from the May 15 low of 4,370 ringgit only extended about 61.8% of the preceding trend from the December 19 low of 3,893 ringgit, the bullish flat pattern is likely to be confirmed.
